title: Totals over a filtered set in employees

steps.title: COUNT of * where id > 1
steps.prompt:
A WHERE filter can narrow a total.
SQL filters the rows first, then count runs on what is left.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM employees WHERE id > 1;
hints: Write: SELECT count(*) FROM employees WHERE id > 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM employees WHERE id > 1;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE first, then the total - the filter still counts.
